capabilities: log habits from a carousel dashboard, compact list, or sidebar panel
schedule daily, weekly, monthly, every-N-days, and flexible-quota habits with at-least or at-most goals
track streaks, completion rates, perfect days, and per-habit heatmaps
embed dashboards, tables, and metric charts in notes via code blocks
export printable PDF reports and write reminders for the Reminder plugin
extras: AI summaries are an experimental, opt-in, bring-your-own-key feature working with OpenAI-compatible services including local ones like Ollama; several other features (note habits, rescheduling) are also behind experimental toggles. All data is stored as plain Markdown notes, so history survives plugin removal.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in habit tracking, so users must track streaks, daily routines, and completion stats outside their vault.

relations.evidence: Habits with planned times can feed the community Reminder plugin.
if the Templater plugin is installed, it's expanded the same way Templater's own "new note from template" command would

summary: Habit tracker that logs daily habits with streaks, stats, charts, and heatmaps from a dashboard or sidebar panel, storing each habit as a Markdown note.
